name: agent_update
description: Update an existing agent's configuration, persona, and/or injection. This allows agents to modify other agents' settings.

id.description: ID of the agent to update

name.description: New human-readable name for the agent

description.description: New description of what this agent does

color.description: New hex color code for UI display

hidden.description: Whether to hide this agent from UI listings

tools.description: New tool restrictions for this agent

skills.description: Skills allocated to this agent (skill names)

enableInjection.description: Whether to enable dynamic prompt injection

persona.description: New persona and system prompt content
